pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-to-large irregular polygonal patches with soft, blurred edge gradients. Geometries on the flank are primarily non-uniform quadrilaterals and pentagons with moderate spatial area relative to the corridor network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the darker patches. Junction nodes are frequent, predominantly characterized by three-way intersections. The thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the upper neck line, characterized by a soft pixel transition against the background.
